title: Rabbi Simon son of Rabbi Yehoshua
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 28:9, but Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be as the statement is cited in Pesikta deRav Kahana 70b: “Rabbi Simon in the name of RYBL [רי״בל].”[^1]

notes.text: The whole selected Torat Emet Vayikra Rabbah 28 paragraph has Rabbi Simon beRabbi Yehoshua, supporting the local titles in the heading. The request for 28:9 was unavailable; the actual catalogue gives six paragraphs in chapter 28, and the positive comparison is stored in its fifth paragraph. This does not repair Hyman’s 28:9 locator. His Pesikta deRav Kahana 70b comparison was not freshly collated; רי״בל is therefore left visible as RYBL rather than supplied with an unsupported personal expansion. The filiation and Hyman’s proposed transmission remain distinct.
